Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4649946. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join, and filter by assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649946' with activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL and activities.standard_relation = '='. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
